soldier: Head light yellowish brown, mandibles brown with a reddish tinge and slightly transparent, head setae sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.59–0.62, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin straight, frons flat. Labrum lanceolate, apex triangular, the apical, subapical and lateral apical setae all distinct. Mandibles rather stout, the curved apex short; mandible length 0.55–0.58 times head capsule length and 0.89–0.95 times head width. Antennae 15–16 segments. Broad region of the postmentum before the anterior fifth; waist region long and nearly parallel, waist constriction index 0.33–0.39. Pronotum trapezoidal and rather high, 1.43–1.55 times as wide as long, anterior incision broad and deep, posterior incision very shallow; more than 10 setae in the middle region.
